description: Fork of exp099 testing per-head sparse VectorToDominance: each head's QK ranking uses an independent random subset of n_pairs=256 pairs (instead of full d_qk*(d_qk-1)/2=861). 256 is slightly above d_qk*log(d_qk) = 42*log(42) ~= 157. Reduces D_QK_P 861 -> 256 (3.4x SDPA reduction). Goal: verify sparse dominance does not significantly hurt loss. All other settings (E=256, d_qk=d_v=42, all three SparseLut modules) match exp099.
